style_authority.note: Treats the sheet as a calm repeated-use operations control and keeps motion only where it preserves causality, state, and direct manipulation.

reference_selection.note: Uses the projected motion-quality, interaction-physics, accessibility, product-context, and validation guidance relevant to the gesture implementation.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Questions which motion should exist, removes decorative whole-sheet scaling and broad transitions, and does not treat more animation as better.

evidence_level.note: Labels the evidence L0 static and avoids claiming observed jank, frame rate, computed-style behavior, Reduced Motion behavior, or device feel.

verified_boundary.note: Separates source-visible ownership, tracking, timing, and missing branches from unverified cascade, performance, responsive, input, focus, and device behavior.

design_moves.note: Provides eight concrete moves for pointer feedback, gesture ownership, transform tracking, interruption, CSS px/s velocity, target semantics, boundaries, and Reduced Motion.

scope_control.note: Remains read-only and motion-specific within 148 lines, with exactly five blockers, eight moves, and decisive validation work.
